steps.label: Authenticate UCPath + CRM
steps.note: authSteps:true — kernel-prepended, parallel-ready. UCPath requires SSO + Duo MFA (duo-autopilot extension auto-clears Duo in headless sessions). CRM is Salesforce SSO (ACT CRM). Each system's BrowserContext is shared across up to 4 pool workers (shared-context-pool mode, poolSize:4); each worker opens its own Page on first ctx.page(id) call.

EID path: fills emplIdInput directly, PeopleSoft auto-redirects to detail page on single match. Both paths capture a screenshot of the final page state.

steps.label: CRM Cross-Verification + CRM Start Date
steps.note: crossVerificationStep in workflow.ts. Runs for BOTH name and EID inputs. EID path: searchCrmByEidOrName (EID query first, name fallback) — sources Start Date from CRM without EID disambiguation. Name path: searchCrmByName (multi-query strategy) — additionally runs matchCrmEid to pick the right SDCMP candidate. CRM Start Date is the operator-facing value; UCPath Last Hire is backend-only. captureAndStampScreenshot: 'crmRecordScreenshot' on found record, 'crmSearchScreenshot' on empty/error.

notes: Four canonical handler steps (searching → cross-verification → active-status → crm-dates) declared in `defineWorkflow`. crm-dates is always in the steps tuple but skipped via ctx.skipStep unless input.includeCrmDates === true, so the step list is consistent across all runs.

Shared-context-pool mode (poolSize:4): up to 4 workers share UCPath + CRM BrowserContexts; each worker opens its own Page on first ctx.page(id) call (lazy allocation). Queue-based distribution — workers pull items from a shared queue until empty.

Input subject resolver: emplId-in-input → 'eid' kind → personOrgSummary EID path + CRM EID search; else → 'name' kind → multi-attempt name search + CRM name search. isEidInput(input) is the runtime discriminator.

Name search strategy: up to 4 attempts (full name → first-only → middle-as-first → multi-token last name). Stops at first attempt that yields SDCMP candidates. Each attempt re-navigates fresh because PeopleSoft breaks the form after 'No matching values'.

CRM match outcomes (name-path): 'direct' (UCPath EID in CRM record) | 'date' (CRM firstDayOfService within ±7 days of UCPath startDate) | 'crm-only' (CRM has EID but UCPath had no SDCMP) | 'none' (CRM records found but no match) | '' (no CRM records at all).

crm-only path in active-status is a re-query UCPath branch: name input where UCPath returned 0 SDCMP rows but CRM had a valid EID; active-status must re-fetch UCPath Person Org by that EID to get the full assignment detail.

Cross-verification runs for BOTH EID and name inputs: EID inputs search CRM by EID first (then name fallback) to source the CRM Start Date. stampActiveCheckFields must NOT overwrite startDate set by cross-verification.

separations conditionally delegates to person-lookup (ctx.delegateTo at identity-check step) only when Workforce Job Summary name-match is suspicious (classifyNameSimilarity → 'different' or EID not-found). Normal separations runs skip the delegation entirely.
Dashboard input run is the only public start path. npm run person-lookup:stop stops the daemon pool. No upload run — person-lookup is typed-input only (name or EID).
